faq.intro: The things people ask us most before their first visit.
items: Is the first consultation really free?
Yes. NewDermaMed offers complimentary consultations so you can discuss your goals and explore treatment options before committing.
Uptown: 4763 Yonge Street, Toronto, ON M2N 5M5. Downtown: 790 Bay Street, Suite 900, Toronto, ON M5G 1N8.
Both clinics are open Monday to Friday, 9am – 7pm, and Saturday, 10am – 5pm.
How do I check the price of a treatment?
Prices are listed by category on our pricing page, along with current offers. Your provider confirms the final price after your consultation.
Are prices the same at both locations?
Yes. Listed prices and promotions apply at both clinics unless otherwise noted.
Yes. We offer flexible payment plans through Affirm for Canadian residents aged 19+, with a minimum $500 purchase.
Most people see long-term reduction. Maintenance sessions may be needed, and results vary by individual.
How can I book an appointment?
Call or text either clinic, email info@newdermamed.com, or book online, we’ll confirm your time and location.
